posts.title: on melancholy hill
posts.description: Hello, It’s been a horribly long time. I now only journal when I’m travelling, and travelling I am - I’m currently on the Eurostar back from Paris. I don’t like to scroll or watch TV on trains - I very much enjoy an above-ground train ride, unlike a plane or a tube, and so I’ve spent the last hour or so looking over French fields and contemplating. posts.description: An old entry, written on a napkin, 11/09/26: In Budapest.
